01About

I am an AI engineer and researcher working on large language models and the agents built on them. I design agent systems at CodePresso and am pursuing an M.Sc. in Computer Science at Ton Duc Thang University.

My research focuses on LLM distillation, chain-of-thought reasoning and LLM-based agents. Earlier, I worked on retrieval-augmented generation for Vietnamese legal documents, parameter-efficient fine-tuning for domain-specific question answering, and persona-driven synthetic data for depression screening (SOICT 2025).

At CodePresso, I build AI agents that automate workflows in education and take them from prototype to production, with a close eye on performance and operating cost. I also coach Ton Duc Thang University’s teams for the Vietnam Student AI Olympiad.
